flags.reason: "Without a limit there is no counter." is true only by default: with showCounter set and no maxLength the installed MessageField shows a plain count (MessageField.tsx, 0.1.78-dbe0e02, read from source). An agent reading this rule would think showCounter does nothing without a limit. Guide fix #518. Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-batch5, for Marcin to confirm.

"a counter that shows only with a limit" (the guide's Sources note) is true only by default: with showCounter set and no maxLength the installed MessageField shows a plain count (the entry's showCounter fact; MessageField.tsx, 0.1.78-dbe0e02, read from source). Same problem as /configuration/1: guide fix #518. Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-r20 (release 0.1.78+20), for Marcin to confirm.

"The counter sits 8 px below." holds only with no message under the field: with support text or an error message, the message sits between the text area and the counter (the entry's errorMessage fact; MessageField.tsx, 0.1.78-dbe0e02, read from source). Guide fix #518. Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-r20 (release 0.1.78+20), for Marcin to confirm.

examples.purpose: Report a problem, the guide's In context: a Card holds a required field with a 500-character limit and a Submit Button. The screen owns the text (value and onChangeText); when people tap Submit it checks the message and sets isInvalid, and errorMessage says what to fix. The button stays enabled.
examples.jsx:
<Card>
  <VStack>
    <MessageField
      label="Describe your issue"
      placeholder="What happened, and when?"
      maxLength={500}
      isRequired
      value=""
      onChangeText={() => {}}
      isInvalid={false}
      errorMessage="Add a few more details, at least 20 characters"
    />
    <Button label="Submit" onPress={() => {}} />
  </VStack>
</Card>

from.quote: The screen checks the message when people tap Submit and sets the error on the field.

props.name: label
props.description: Label rendered above the textarea.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text shown when the textarea is empty.

props.name: value
props.description: Current value of the textarea (controlled). When provided, the consumer is responsible for updating it via `onChangeText`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value when used uncontrolled. Ignored when `value` is provided.

props.name: onChangeText
props.description: Called whenever the text changes. Fires for both controlled and uncontrolled use.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name. When the field is rendered inside a `<Form>`, this is the key used to look up server-side `validationErrors` and to clear the error when the value changes.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Typing stops at the limit, and the counter then reads the limit out of the limit (200/200 for 200). Declared: Maximum number of characters accepted. Drives the counter when `showCounter` is not explicitly false.

props.name: showCounter
props.description: With showCounter and no maxLength, the counter shows a bare count. Declared: Controls visibility of the character counter. - Default: counter is shown when `maxLength` is provided. - `true`: always show counter (shows `<count>/<maxLength>` when `maxLength` is set, or just `<count>` otherwise). - `false`: never show counter.

props.name: rows
props.description: The text area is rows × 21 + 24 px tall when rows is set, otherwise the 108 px token (four rows); text scrolls inside it. Declared: Number of visible text rows. When provided, overrides the default `messageField/textarea/height` token to derive the textarea height as `rows * lineHeight + 2 * padding`.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: On the web the text area has aria-required, and the asterisk uses the Negative (red) token. Declared: Renders a required indicator (asterisk) next to the label. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: On the web a disabled field has aria-disabled and tabindex -1, so Tab skips it. Declared: Disables interaction and applies the Disabled token mode. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Marks the field as invalid and resolves to the `Error` state token mode. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Replaces supportText only while the field is invalid; the message sits between the text area and the counter. Declared: Message shown under the field when `isInvalid` is set. Also used for a Form validation error.

props.name: supportText
props.description: Supporting line under the field. Replaced by `errorMessage` while invalid.

props.name: isReadOnly
props.description: Read-only, non-interactive but not dimmed. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Auto-focus the textarea on mount. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: modes
props.description: Modes for design token resolution (e.g. `{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }`).

props.name: style
props.description: Style overrides for the outermost wrapper.

props.name: textareaStyle
props.description: Style overrides for the textarea container (border/padding/etc).

props.name: inputStyle
props.description: Style overrides for the input text.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessibility label. Defaults to `label` or `placeholder`.

props.name: accessibilityHint
props.description: Accessibility hint.

props.name: testID
props.description: Test identifier.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Called when the textarea receives focus.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when the textarea loses focus.

modes.name: Color Mode
modes.description: A token collection MessageField reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: FormField States
modes.description: MessageField sets this mode itself from its props and focus: invalid gives Error, then disabled gives Disabled, read-only gives Read Only, focus gives Active, otherwise Idle. A value passed in modes is ignored. Declared: A token collection MessageField reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

events.name: onChangeText
events.description: Called whenever the text changes. Fires for both controlled and uncontrolled use.

gaps.text: Figma's Message Field has a fixed “0/140” counter and its states are variable modes; the package adds the required mark, a rows option, a counter that shows only with a limit, and support text or an error message below the text area, none of which Figma has.
